tool_routing: Gateway architecture: single long-lived Gateway owns all messaging surfaces, exposes typed WS API with requests/responses/events
Tools defined in ~/.../docs/tools/ — each tool has its own doc with schema. Tools invoke via HTTP API at /openresponses/... or gateway WS API
Config-tools system: tools can be enabled/disabled per agent via agents.defaults.tools/agents.list[].tools allow/deny lists
Exec tool has approval gates (exec-approvals.md): permission levels, approval UI, and elevated mode for sensitive commands
memory_system: Three memory-related files: MEMORY.md (long-term curated), memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md (daily notes), DREAMS.md (optional dream diary)
Files are plain Markdown — no hidden state. Memory_search uses hybrid search (vector + keyword)
Pluggable memory backends: builtin (SQLite), QMD (local-first), Honcho (AI-native cross-session), LanceDB
Dreaming system: optional background consolidation, scores candidates, promotes qualified to MEMORY.md
Memory-wiki plugin: compiles durable knowledge into wiki vault with claims, evidence, contradiction tracking
session_mgmt: Sessions organized by source: DMs share one session by default, group chats isolated per group, cron jobs get fresh session per run
DM isolation modes: main, per-peer, per-channel-peer, per-account-channel-peer
Session lifecycle: daily reset (4AM local), idle reset (configurable), manual reset (/new or /reset)
Session state owned by gateway, stored at ~/.openclaw/agents/<agentId>/sessions/sessions.json + transcripts as JSONL
Session maintenance: auto-cleanup with warn/enforce modes, pruneAfter, maxEntries
context_mgmt: Context engine: pluggable system controlling message assembly, compaction, subagent lifecycle
Four lifecycle points: ingest → assemble → compact → after turn
Legacy engine: pass-through assembly, built-in summarization compaction. Plugin engines can implement custom strategies
System prompt assembled from: OpenClaw base prompt + skills prompt + bootstrap context + per-run overrides
Bootstrap files injected: AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY.md
Bootstrap limits: maxChars per file (default 12000), totalMaxChars (default 60000)
security_model: THREAT MODEL documented in security/THREAT-MODEL-ATLAS.md with formal verification
WebSocket auth modes: shared-secret, trusted-proxy, Tailscale, none (private ingress only)
Sandboxing: sandbox vs tool-policy vs elevated — three tier security model
Exec approvals: permission levels, approval UI with allow-once per command
Device pairing: new device IDs require approval, challenge nonce signing
CLI_UX: openclaw CLI commands: agents, channels, status, doctor, sessions, cron, gateway, memory, plugins, security
Status card shows: model, usage, time, cost, tasks. /status in chat shows context usage
Gateway control: foreground daemon, systemd/launchd supervision
mcp_protocol: Mentioned as an extension point but OpenClaw does not use MCP as primary protocol
Gateway uses its own WebSocket protocol with JSON frames: connect request → typed messages with req/res/event lifecycle
No direct MCP server/client documentation found in core docs
execution_model: Agent loop: intake → context assembly → model inference → tool execution → streaming → persistence
Serialized per session: runs queued per session key + optional global lane to prevent race conditions
Streaming: assistant deltas, tool events, lifecycle events all streamed through WS events
Timeouts: agent runtime default 172800s (48h), agent.wait default 30s, model idle watchdog
Plugin hooks: before/after tool call, before/after compaction, message lifecycle, session lifecycle
Subagents: sessions_spawn for isolated child sessions, push-based completion notification
